headline: UBC timetable maker for Workday course schedules.
lead: Use this UBC schedule maker and UBC course table maker to turn View My Courses Excel into a weekly grid, or add UBC classes by hand. Nothing is uploaded.
whatTitle: A UBC course table maker that stays in your browser
whatBody: Timetable Craft is a UBC timetable maker for weekly classes. Import the Excel file from UBC Workday View My Courses, or type course codes, days, and rooms yourself. You choose which lectures, labs, and waitlisted sections appear on the course table.
whatMore: Workday remains the source of record. This page is not affiliated with UBC. Confirm times and rooms in Workday before you rely on the PNG.
howTitle: How the UBC schedule maker works
importBody: Export Excel from Workday, then import it here. Parsing runs locally so your UBC course list never leaves this device.
manualTitle: Or add UBC classes by hand
manualBody: No spreadsheet? Enter each section the same way you would in any course table maker. Winter and Summer terms stay on one timetable, switched by term chips.
gridBody: Check the classes to display, restyle the card, and download a PNG. Waitlist sections use a dashed box; dropped sections use a dotted box.
diffTitle: UBC timetable maker vs a generic schedule maker
diffBody: The same Schedule Maker tool also works as a general timetable maker. This UBC page is for students searching for a UBC course table maker: Workday Excel import, UBC terms, and registration statuses. If you are not at UBC, start from the homepage schedule maker instead.
q1: What is a UBC timetable maker?
a1: A UBC timetable maker turns your UBC class list into a weekly grid. Timetable Craft does that in the browser: import Workday View My Courses Excel or add courses by hand, then export a PNG.
q2: Is this a UBC schedule maker or a UBC course table maker?
a2: Those searches describe the same tool. This page is the UBC schedule maker and UBC course table maker path: Workday Excel, UBC terms, and waitlist or dropped sections.
q3: Does the UBC timetable maker upload my Workday Excel?
a3: No. Parsing stays in this tab. Closing the page does not send your course file to a server.
seoTitle: UBC Timetable Maker & Course Table | Timetable Craft
seoDescription: Free UBC timetable maker and UBC schedule maker. Import Workday View My Courses Excel or add classes, then export a weekly course table PNG. No upload.
